source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 10 (PDF 212-243), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 10 (Electrochemistry) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define electrochemistry.
(Electrochemistry ki taareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrochemistry chemistry ki woh shakh hai jo bijli ki energy aur chemical energy ke aapas mein tabdeel hone se mutalliq hai, yaani bijli se chemical energy aur chemical energy se bijli.

book_ref.quote: deals with inter conversion of electrical and chemical energy

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between oxidation and reduction in terms of electrons.
(Electrons ke lihaz se oxidation aur reduction mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono processes ka muqabla neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: Here Fe⁺² and Zn⁰ have lost electrons, therefore they are oxidized.

rows: Electron ya electrons ka kho dena.
Electron ya electrons hasil karna.
Maslan Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻; Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻
Maslan Cl + e⁻ → Cl⁻; Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu
Oxidation number barhta hai.
Oxidation number ghat-ta hai.

blocks.prompt:
3 What are redox reactions? Give two examples from living things.
(Redox reactions kya hain? Jaandaaron se do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation aur reduction hamesha aik saath hote hain; aisi reactions redox reactions kehlati hain. Photosynthesis (jo zameen ke liye khoraak banati hai) aur respiration (jo hamein zinda rakhti hai) dono redox reactions hain.

book_ref.quote: The reactions in which this happens is called redox reactions.

blocks.prompt:
4 Name the two ways of finding out whether a substance has been oxidized or reduced in a reaction.
(Kisi reaction mein substance oxidize hua ya reduce, yeh maloom karne ke do tareeqe bataein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Electron transfer: electrons khona oxidation, hasil karna reduction. (2) Oxidation number ki tabdeeli: barhna oxidation, ghatna reduction.

book_ref.quote: There are two ways of finding out whether or not a substance has been oxidized or reduced

blocks.prompt:
5 Define oxidation number. What do higher positive and higher negative values show?
(Oxidation number ki taareef karein. Zyada positive aur zyada negative qeematein kya dikhati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oxidation number (oxidation state) woh number hai jo compound mein har atom ya ion ko diya jata hai aur us ki oxidation ka darja dikhata hai; yeh molecule ya ion mein atom ka zahiri charge hai. Zyada positive ka matlab zyada oxidized, zyada negative ka matlab zyada reduced.

book_ref.quote: An oxidation number is a number given to each atom or ion in a compound that shows us its degree of oxidation.

blocks.prompt:
6 State the fixed oxidation numbers of group 1 metals, group 2 metals, hydrogen and oxygen in compounds, with their exceptions.
(Compounds mein group 1, group 2 metals, hydrogen aur oxygen ke muqarrar oxidation numbers un ki istisna (exceptions) ke saath bataein.)
blocks.explanation: Group 1 alkali metals hamesha +1 aur group 2 elements hamesha +2. Hydrogen +1 hai, magar metal hydrides jaise NaH mein −1. Oxygen −2 hai, magar peroxides mein −1 aur F₂O mein +2.

book_ref.quote: In compounds, many atoms or ions have fixed oxidation numbers

blocks.prompt:
7 What is the sum of oxidation numbers in (i) a neutral molecule (ii) an ion?
(Oxidation numbers ka majmua kya hota hai: (i) neutral molecule mein (ii) ion mein?)
blocks.explanation: (i) Neutral molecule mein tamam elements ke oxidation numbers ka algebraic majmua zero hai (maslan HCl, NaCl). (ii) Ion mein majmua ion ke charge ke barabar hai (maslan CO₃²⁻ ka −2, SO₄²⁻ ka −2).

book_ref.quote: The sum of the oxidation numbers in a compound is zero.

blocks.prompt:
8 Give the oxidation number of oxygen in H₂O, Na₂O₂ and KO₂.
(H₂O, Na₂O₂ aur KO₂ mein oxygen ka oxidation number bataein.)

book_ref.quote: Oxygen shows -2, -1 and -1/2 in H₂O, Na₂O₂, and KO₂ respectively.

blocks.prompt:
9 What are compound ions? Calculate the oxidation number of nitrogen in NO₃⁻.
(Compound ions kya hain? NO₃⁻ mein nitrogen ka oxidation number nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Compound ions woh ions hain jin mein do ya zyada mukhtalif atoms hon, maslan SO₄²⁻ aur NO₃⁻. NO₃⁻ mein: N + 3(−2) = −1, is liye N = −1 + 6 = +5.

book_ref.quote: Compound ions are ions with two or more different atoms.

blocks.prompt:
10 Calculate the oxidation number of (i) Mn in K₂MnO₄ (ii) Cl in NaClO₄.
(Oxidation number nikalein: (i) K₂MnO₄ mein Mn (ii) NaClO₄ mein Cl.)

book_ref.quote: (Ox. No. of K) + (Ox. No. of Mn) + 4 (Ox. No. of O) = 0

blocks.prompt:
11 Calculate the oxidation number of (i) S in H₂S (ii) N in NH₄⁺.
(Oxidation number nikalein: (i) H₂S mein S (ii) NH₄⁺ mein N.)
blocks.explanation: (i) 2(+1) + S = 0, is liye S = −2 (S hydrogen se zyada electronegative hai). (ii) N + 4(+1) = +1, is liye N = −3.

book_ref.quote: A metal always has the positive Ox. No. and nonmetals have the negative Ox. state

blocks.prompt:
12 How is the sign of the oxidation number decided in a compound of two non-metals? Find the oxidation number of S in SO₃.
(Do non-metals ke compound mein oxidation number ka sign kaise tay hota hai? SO₃ mein S ka oxidation number nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Sign electronegativity par munhasir hai; sab se zyada electronegative element (yahan O) ko negative sign milta hai. SO₃ mein: S + 3(−2) = 0, is liye S = +6.

book_ref.quote: The most electronegative element is given the negative sign.

blocks.prompt:
13 Define a disproportionation reaction and give one example.
(Disproportionation reaction ki taareef karein aur aik misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Disproportionation reaction woh hai jis mein aik hi substance oxidizing aur reducing agent dono ka kaam kare aur mukhtalif oxidation states wale do products banen. Misaal: 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂ (oxygen −1 se −2 aur 0 mein).

book_ref.quote: resulting in two different products with different oxidation states

blocks.prompt:
14 Show that the reaction of chlorine with sodium hydroxide, 6NaOH + 3Cl₂ → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O, is a disproportionation.
(Saabit karein ke 6NaOH + 3Cl₂ → 5NaCl + NaClO₃ + 3H₂O disproportionation hai.)
blocks.explanation: Chlorine Cl₂ mein 0 par hai. NaCl mein −1 tak reduce aur NaClO₃ mein +5 tak oxidize hoti hai. Aik hi element aik saath oxidize aur reduce hota hai, is liye yeh disproportionation hai.

book_ref.quote: Oxidation number of chlorine in NaCl = –1 (Cl is reduced from 0 to -1)

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is the decomposition of H₂O₂ into H₂O and O₂ called a disproportionation reaction?
(H₂O₂ ka H₂O aur O₂ mein toot-na disproportionation kyun kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: H₂O₂ mein oxygen −1 hai. H₂O mein −2 (reduce) aur O₂ mein 0 (oxidize) ho jati hai. Aik hi element (oxygen) aik saath oxidize aur reduce hota hai, is liye H₂O₂ oxidizing aur reducing agent dono hai.

book_ref.quote: This type of reaction involves the simultaneous oxidation and reduction of the same element.

blocks.prompt:
16 Differentiate between an oxidizing agent and a reducing agent.
(Oxidizing agent aur reducing agent mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono ka muqabla neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: and is itself oxidized to a higher oxidation state by losing one or more electrons

rows: Doosre substance ko oxidize karta hai.
Doosre substance ko reduce karta hai.
Khud electrons hasil kar ke reduce hota hai.
Khud electrons kho kar oxidize hota hai.
Is ka oxidation number ghat-ta hai.
Is ka oxidation number barhta hai.
Maslan Cl + e⁻ → Cl⁻
Maslan Na → Na⁺ + e⁻

blocks.prompt:
17 Why is an element that gains electrons called an oxidizing agent?
(Electrons hasil karne wala element oxidizing agent kyun kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrons hasil karne wala element yeh electrons doosre atom se kheenchta hai, is liye doosra atom oxidize hota hai. Element khud reduce hota hai aur us ka oxidation number ghat-ta hai (maslan Cl → Cl⁻ mein 0 se −1).

book_ref.quote: If an element M gains one or more electrons and is converted into M⁻ anion

blocks.text: 10.5 Balancing redox equations by the oxidation number method

blocks.prompt:
18 List the steps of balancing a redox equation by the oxidation number method.
(Oxidation number method se redox equation balance karne ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Skeleton equation likhein. (2) Jin elements ka oxidation number badalta hai unhein pehchan kar un ke upar numbers likhein. (3) Teer se jor kar hasil/khoye electrons dikhayein. (4) Munasib adad se zarb de kar izafa aur kami barabar karein. (5) Baqi inspection se balance karein.

book_ref.quote: Record the oxidation number above the symbols of the element

blocks.prompt:
19 In what order are atoms balanced by the inspection (hit and trial) method?
(Inspection (hit and trial) method mein atoms kis tarteeb se balance kiye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle nitrogen, oxygen aur hydrogen ke ilawa tamam elements ke atoms; doosre nitrogen (agar ho); teesre oxygen; aakhir mein hydrogen.

book_ref.quote: Sequence of the balancing the chemical equation using inspection (hit and trial) method.

blocks.prompt:
20 In balancing K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → KCl + CrCl₃ + Cl₂ + H₂O, why is the oxidation half multiplied by 3?
(K₂Cr₂O₇ + HCl → KCl + CrCl₃ + Cl₂ + H₂O balance karte waqt oxidation half ko 3 se kyun zarb diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do Cr atoms +6 se +3 hote hain, har K₂Cr₂O₇ ke liye 6 units kami. Do Cl⁻ ka Cl₂ banna sirf 2 units izafa hai. Oxidation half (2HCl → Cl₂) ko 3 se zarb dene se 6 units bante hain, yun khoye aur hasil kiye electrons barabar ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Increase in Ox. No. of Cl is 2 units for 2 molecules of HCl.

blocks.prompt:
21 Why is HNO₃ written twice on the left in balancing Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + NO₂ + H₂O?
(Cu + HNO₃ → Cu(NO₃)₂ + NO₂ + H₂O balance karte waqt HNO₃ baayen taraf do dafa kyun likha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: HNO₃ ki kuch nitrogen ka oxidation number badalta hai (NO₂ mein +5 se +4) aur baqi ka nahi badalta (Cu(NO₃)₂ mein +5). Is liye HNO₃ reactant taraf do dafa likha jata hai: aik tabdeeli ke liye, aik baghair tabdeeli ke liye.

book_ref.quote: First, for change in oxidation number while second is for no change in oxidation number.

blocks.prompt:
22 Define an electrolytic cell and name its main parts.
(Electrolytic cell ki taareef karein aur is ke bare hisse bataein.)
blocks.explanation: Electrolytic cell woh aala hai jo electrolysis ke zariye bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai. Hisse: electrolyte (pighla ionic compound ya ions ka gaarha aqueous solution), carbon (graphite) ya metal ke do electrodes (anode positive, cathode negative), aur direct current power supply.

book_ref.quote: An electrolytic cell is a device that converts electrical energy into chemical energy

blocks.prompt:
23 Give four uses of electrolytic cells.
(Electrolytic cells ke chaar istemal bataein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Sodium chloride ki electrolysis se sodium aur chlorine banana. (2) Metals ki refining (safai). (3) Metals ki plating. (4) Caustic soda jaise chemicals banana.

book_ref.quote: Electrolysis is also used to produce non-metals such as chlorine and to purify metals.

blocks.prompt:
24 Why is electrolysis called a redox process?
(Electrolysis ko redox process kyun kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrolysis mein positive ions cathode par electrons lete hain (reduction) aur negative ions anode par electrons dete hain (oxidation). Dono aik saath hote hain, is liye electrolysis redox reaction hai.

book_ref.quote: This movement of ions and transfer of electrons results in chemical changes at the electrodes

blocks.prompt:
25 Write the electrode reactions for the electrolysis of molten ZnCl₂.
(Pighle hue ZnCl₂ ki electrolysis ke electrode reactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cathode (reduction): Zn²⁺(l) + 2e⁻ → Zn(s). Anode (oxidation): 2Cl⁻(l) → Cl₂(g) + 2e⁻. Mukammal: ZnCl₂(l) → Zn(s) + Cl₂(g).

book_ref.quote: If metal atoms are formed, they may be deposited as a layer of metal on the cathode.

blocks.prompt:
26 Write the cathode and anode reactions when molten CuBr₂ is electrolyzed using inert electrodes.
(Pighle hue CuBr₂ ki inert electrodes se electrolysis mein cathode aur anode ke reactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cathode (reduction): Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu. Anode (oxidation): 2Br⁻ → Br₂ + 2e⁻. Mukammal: CuBr₂ → Cu + Br₂.

book_ref.quote: Molten copper (II) bromide (CuBr₂) is electrolyzed using inert electrodes.

blocks.prompt:
27 Write the anode reaction when hydroxide ions are discharged during electrolysis.
(Electrolysis mein hydroxide ions discharge hon to anode ka reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hydroxide ions anode ki taraf ja kar electrons khote hain (oxidation): 4OH⁻(aq) → O₂(g) + 2H₂O(l) + 4e⁻.

book_ref.quote: The negative ions (anions) move to the anode.

blocks.text: 10.8 Mass of a substance deposited during electrolysis

blocks.prompt:
28 Define one Faraday. What is its value?
(Aik Faraday ki taareef karein. Is ki qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik Faraday (F) woh charge hai jo 1 mole electrons ya 1 mole aik charge wale ions le jate hain. Is ki qeemat 96500 C mol⁻¹ hai.

book_ref.quote: 1 Faraday is the quantity of electric charge carried by 1 mole of electrons

blocks.prompt:
29 On what factors does the mass of a substance produced at an electrode depend?
(Electrode par bannay wale substance ka mass kin cheezon par munhasir hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh constant current ki taqat (I) aur us ke guzarne ke waqt (t) ke mutanasib hai, yaani bijli ki miqdaar Q = I × t (coulombs) ke mutanasib.

book_ref.quote: The mass of a substance produced at an electrode during electrolysis is proportional to the time

blocks.prompt:
30 Why is 1 Faraday enough to deposit 1 mole of silver but 2 Faradays are needed for 1 mole of copper?
(1 mole silver ke liye 1 Faraday kaafi hai magar 1 mole copper ke liye 2 Faraday kyun chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Ag⁺ + e⁻ → Ag mein har mole Ag ke liye 1 mole electrons, yaani 1 F. Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu mein har mole Cu ke liye 2 mole electrons, yaani 2 F = 2 × 96500 C. Faradays ki tadaad = hasil ya khoye electrons ke moles.

book_ref.quote: The equation shows that 2 moles of electrons are needed to produce 1 mole of copper

blocks.prompt:
31 A current of 0.500 A flows through a cell for 32 min 10 s. Calculate the charge passed and the number of Faradays.
(Aik cell mein 0.500 A current 32 minute 10 second tak guzarta hai. Guzarne wala charge aur Faradays ki tadaad nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Where Q = Charge (in coulombs, C)

blocks.prompt:
32 Calculate the mass of silver deposited by 9650 C passed through silver nitrate solution (Ag = 108 g mol⁻¹).
(Silver nitrate solution mein 9650 C guzarne se kitni silver jamegi? (Ag = 108 g mol⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: Ag⁺ + e⁻ → Ag. e⁻ ke moles = 9650/96500 = 0.100 mol = Ag ke moles. Mass = 0.100 × 108 = 10.8 g.

book_ref.quote: During the electrolysis of silver nitrate solution, silver is deposited at the cathode.

blocks.text: 10.9 Amount of substance produced during electrolysis

blocks.prompt:
33 Calculate the mass of lead deposited when 3.00 A flows through molten PbBr₂ for 10.0 min (Pb = 207, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹).
(Pighle hue PbBr₂ mein 3.00 A current 10.0 minute tak guzarne se kitna lead jamega? (Pb = 207, F = 96500 C mol⁻¹))

book_ref.quote: Step 3 Calculate the charge transferred during the electrolysis.

blocks.prompt:
34 How long must a current of 2.00 A pass through copper(II) sulfate solution to deposit 1.27 g of copper (Cu = 63.5)?
(Copper(II) sulfate solution mein 1.27 g copper jamane ke liye 2.00 A current kitni der guzarna chahiye? (Cu = 63.5))

book_ref.quote: 193000 C deposits 1 mole Pb, which is 207 g Pb

blocks.prompt:
35 Why must the half-equation be written first when calculating the mass deposited in electrolysis?
(Electrolysis mein jamne wala mass nikalte waqt pehle half-equation kyun likhi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Half-equation batati hai ke har mole product ke liye kitne mole electrons chahiye (maslan Pb²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Pb mein 2), aur is tarah 1 mole jamane ke liye kitne coulombs (n × 96500 C).

book_ref.quote: Step 1 Write the half-equation for the reaction.

blocks.text: 10.10 Avogadro's constant by the electrolytic method

blocks.prompt:
36 Define the Avogadro constant and write the relation used to find it by electrolysis.
(Avogadro constant ki taareef karein aur electrolysis se nikalne ka rishta likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Avogadro constant (L) 1 mole mein maujood mukhtass particles (atoms, molecules ya ions) ki tadaad hai. L = 1 mole electrons ka charge / 1 electron ka charge (1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C).

book_ref.quote: An electrolytic method can be used to find a value for the Avogadro constant

blocks.prompt:
37 In the electrolysis of copper(II) sulfate with copper electrodes, why does the cathode gain mass and the anode lose mass?
(Copper electrodes ke saath copper(II) sulfate ki electrolysis mein cathode ka mass kyun barhta aur anode ka kyun ghat-ta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cathode par Cu²⁺ ions electrons le kar copper ban kar jam jate hain, is liye mass barhta hai. Anode par copper atoms Cu²⁺ ions ban kar solution mein chale jate hain, is liye mass ghat-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: The cathode increases in mass because copper is deposited.

blocks.prompt:
38 In an experiment, a copper anode lost 0.0953 g when 0.150 A passed for 32.0 min. Find the charge on 1 mole of electrons (Cu = 63.5).
(Aik tajurbe mein 0.150 A current 32.0 minute guzarne se copper anode 0.0953 g kam hua. 1 mole electrons ka charge nikalein (Cu = 63.5).)
blocks.explanation: Q = 0.150 × 1920 = 288 C. 63.5 g Cu ke liye charge = 288/0.0953 × 63.5 = 191899 C; yeh 2 mol e⁻ hain, is liye 1 mol e⁻ = 9.59 × 10⁴ C.

book_ref.quote: If the charge on one electron is 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C,

blocks.prompt:
39 The charge on 1 mole of electrons is found to be 9.59 × 10⁴ C. Calculate L if the charge on an electron is 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
(1 mole electrons ka charge 9.59 × 10⁴ C aaya. Agar electron ka charge 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C ho to L nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: L = 9.59 × 10⁴ / (1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹) = 5.99 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, jo durust qeemat 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ ke qareeb hai.

book_ref.quote: This is in good agreement with the accurate value of 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹.

blocks.text: 10.11 Electrode potentials (ease of oxidation and reduction)

blocks.prompt:
40 Define electrode potential.
(Electrode potential ki taareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Jab metal ko us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to metal aur solution ke ions ke darmiyan bijli ka potential (voltage) qaim hota hai. Yeh electrode potential hai; yeh substance ki oxidation ya reduction ki asani batata hai aur volts mein naapa jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This is called electrode potential and it indicates the ease of oxidation or reduction of a substance.

blocks.prompt:
41 What two opposing reactions occur when a copper rod is placed in Cu²⁺(aq)?
(Copper rod ko Cu²⁺(aq) mein rakhne par kaun se do mukhalif reactions hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: (a) Metal atoms ions ban kar solution mein jate hain aur rod par electrons chhor dete hain: Cu(s) → Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻. (b) Ions rod se electrons le kar atoms ban kar jam jate hain: Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s). Dono ki raftar barabar hone par equilibrium qaim hota hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two opposing reactions in this equilibrium.

blocks.prompt:
42 Why are Cu²⁺ ions easy to reduce while V²⁺ ions are difficult to reduce?
(Cu²⁺ ions asani se aur V²⁺ ions mushkil se kyun reduce hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Copper kam reactive hai; is ka equilibrium Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Cu zyada daayen hai, is liye Cu²⁺ asani se electrons leta hai. Vanadium reactive hai; is ka equilibrium V²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ V zyada baayen hai, is liye V²⁺ bohat kam electrons leta hai.

book_ref.quote: V²⁺(aq) ions are therefore relatively difficult to reduce.

blocks.prompt:
43 Why can the absolute potential of an electrode not be measured directly?
(Electrode ka absolute potential seedha kyun nahi naapa ja sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Jab metal ko us ke ions ke solution mein rakha jaye to electrical double layer banti hai (metal par zaid electrons, qareeb cations). Is double layer ki wajah se potential seedha nahi naapa ja sakta; sirf doosre system (SHE) se farq naapa ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: So, an electrical double layer is formed.

blocks.prompt:
44 What does a standard hydrogen electrode consist of?
(Standard hydrogen electrode kin cheezon par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: (1) 101 kPa hydrogen gas jo 1.00 mol dm⁻³ H⁺ ions ke saath equilibrium mein ho. (2) Platinum black se dhaka platinum electrode jo hydrogen gas aur H⁺ ions se mila ho. Is ka E° 0.00 V muqarrar hai.

book_ref.quote: A platinum electrode covered with platinum black in contact with the hydrogen gas and the H⁺ ions.

blocks.prompt:
45 Give the reason for coating the platinum electrode of the SHE with platinum black.
(SHE ke platinum electrode par platinum black ki teh kyun lagai jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Platinum black bareek pisa hua platinum hai. Yeh hydrogen gas aur solution ke H⁺ ions ka qareebi rabta deta hai taake H₂ aur H⁺ ka equilibrium jaldi qaim ho. Platinum inert hai aur reaction mein hissa nahi leta.

book_ref.quote: so that equilibrium between H₂ gas and H⁺ ions is established quickly

blocks.prompt:
46 Does the way the hydrogen half-equation is balanced change its E° value? Explain.
(Kya hydrogen half-equation ko balance karne ka tareeqa us ka E° badalta hai? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Chahe 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂ likhein ya H⁺ + e⁻ → ½H₂, E° = 0.00 V. Equation balance karne ka tareeqa element ke electrons lene ke rujhan par asar nahi dalta.

book_ref.quote: The equation does not affect the tendency for the element to gain electrons.

blocks.prompt:
47 Define standard electrode potential and state the standard conditions.
(Standard electrode potential ki taareef karein aur standard halaat bataein.)
blocks.explanation: Half-cell ka standard electrode potential (E°) woh voltage hai jo standard halaat mein naapa jaye jab doosra half-cell standard hydrogen electrode ho. Halaat: ions 1.00 mol dm⁻³, 25 °C (298 K), gases 1 atm (101 kPa).

book_ref.quote: Under these conditions, the electrode potential we measure is called the standard electrode potential.

blocks.prompt:
48 Name the three main types of half-cell whose E° values are measured against the SHE, with one example each.
(Teen bari qisam ke half-cells bataein jin ke E° SHE ke muqable mein naape jate hain, har aik ki misaal ke saath.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Metal/metal ion half-cell, maslan Cu²⁺/Cu. (2) Non-metal/non-metal ion half-cell, maslan Cl⁻/Cl₂. (3) Ion/ion half-cell, maslan Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺.

book_ref.quote: There are three main types of half-cell whose E° value can be obtained

blocks.prompt:
49 Why does the Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell have a negative E° value (−0.76 V)?
(Zn²⁺/Zn half-cell ka E° negative (−0.76 V) kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: SHE se jodne par zinc negative terminal hota hai. Zn²⁺ ions H⁺ ions se mushkil se reduce hote hain, is liye zinc H⁺/H₂ half-cell ko electrons deta hai aur H⁺ unhein leta hai. Zyada negative E° ka matlab mushkil se reduce hona.

book_ref.quote: The E° values show us that Zn²⁺ ions are more difficult to reduce than H⁺ ions

blocks.prompt:
50 At which terminal of a cell does oxidation take place, and at which reduction? Give the reactions for the Zn²⁺/Zn; H⁺/H₂ cell.
(Cell ke kis terminal par oxidation aur kis par reduction hoti hai? Zn²⁺/Zn; H⁺/H₂ cell ke reactions dein.)
blocks.explanation: Negative terminal par oxidation: Zn(s) → Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻. Positive terminal par reduction: 2H⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → H₂(g).

book_ref.quote: Oxidation takes place at the negative terminal of the cell.

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between an electrolytic cell and a galvanic cell.
(Electrolytic cell aur galvanic cell mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cells ka muqabla neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: A galvanic cell is designed to take advantage of spontaneous transfer of electrons.

rows: Bijli ki energy ko chemical energy mein badalta hai.
Chemical energy ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai.
Redox reaction direct current supply se chalaya jata hai.
Redox reaction khud ba khud hota hai.
Anode positive, cathode negative.
Anode (oxidation) negative, cathode (reduction) positive.
Maslan pighle ZnCl₂ ki electrolysis, metals ki refining aur plating.
Maslan Daniel cell, dry cell.

blocks.prompt:
52 What is a salt bridge? Give its function.
(Salt bridge kya hai? Is ka kaam bataein.)
blocks.explanation: Salt bridge filter paper (ya koi aur inert masaam daar cheez) ki patti hai jo potassium nitrate ke saturated solution mein bhigoi gayi ho. Yeh dono half-cells ke darmiyan ions ko chalne de kar circuit mukammal karta hai taake ionic tawazun qaim rahe; electrons is mein se nahi guzarte.

book_ref.quote: a salt bridge to complete the electrical circuit allowing the movement of ions

blocks.prompt:
53 State the standard conditions used to make a Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell.
(Cu²⁺/Cu half-cell banane ke standard halaat bataein.)
blocks.explanation: Khalis copper rod ko 1.00 mol dm⁻³ Cu²⁺(aq) ions ke solution (maslan copper(II) sulfate) mein 25 °C (298 K) par rakha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: the Cu²⁺(aq) ions have a concentration of 1.00 mol dm⁻³

blocks.prompt:
54 Write the anode, cathode and overall reactions of the Zn-Cu galvanic cell.
(Zn-Cu galvanic cell ke anode, cathode aur mukammal reactions likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Anode (oxidation): Zn(s) → Zn²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻. Cathode (reduction): Cu²⁺(aq) + 2e⁻ → Cu(s). Mukammal: Zn(s) + Cu²⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + Cu(s); E°cell = +1.10 V.

book_ref.quote: At the anode, zinc undergoes oxidation, losing electrons to form zinc ions:

blocks.prompt:
55 How are two half-cells connected to make an electrochemical cell?
(Do half-cells ko jor kar electrochemical cell kaise banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: (1) Taarein metal rods ko high-resistance voltmeter se jorti hain; is bahar wale circuit mein electrons zyada negative se zyada positive electrode ki taraf chalte hain. (2) Salt bridge half-cells ke darmiyan ions ko chalne de kar circuit mukammal karta hai.

book_ref.quote: wires connecting the metal rods in each half-cell to a high-resistance voltmeter

blocks.prompt:
56 Calculate the standard cell potential of a cell made from Mg²⁺/Mg (−2.37 V) and Ag⁺/Ag (+0.80 V). Which is the positive pole?
(Mg²⁺/Mg (−2.37 V) aur Ag⁺/Ag (+0.80 V) se bane cell ka standard cell potential nikalein. Positive pole kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: E°cell = E°(zyada positive) − E°(zyada negative) = +0.80 − (−2.37) = +3.17 V. Ag⁺/Ag half-cell (zyada positive E°) positive pole hai.

book_ref.quote: We call this value the standard cell potential (E°Cell)

blocks.prompt:
57 A cell is made from Al³⁺/Al (−1.66 V) and Cu²⁺/Cu (+0.34 V). Find E°cell and the negative pole.
(Al³⁺/Al (−1.66 V) aur Cu²⁺/Cu (+0.34 V) se cell banaya gaya. E°cell aur negative pole bataein.)
blocks.explanation: E°cell = +0.34 − (−1.66) = +2.00 V. Al³⁺/Al half-cell (zyada negative E°) negative pole hai.

book_ref.quote: The voltage of this cell is +0.80 – (–0.76) = +1.56 V as in Figure 10.8 (b).

blocks.prompt:
58 How can E° values be used to find the direction of electron flow in a cell made of Zn²⁺/Zn and Ag⁺/Ag?
(Zn²⁺/Zn aur Ag⁺/Ag ke cell mein E° qeematon se electrons ke bahao ki simt kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zn²⁺/Zn (−0.76 V) Ag⁺/Ag (+0.80 V) se zyada negative hai, is liye Zn²⁺ mushkil se reduce hota hai. Zn electrons khota hai jo bahar wali taar mein Zn half-cell (negative pole) se Ag half-cell (positive pole) ki taraf jate hain, electrolyte mein se nahi.

book_ref.quote: We can deduce the direction of electron flow in the wires in the external circuit

blocks.prompt:
59 What does a more positive and a less positive E° value tell us about a half-equation?
(Zyada positive aur kam positive E° qeemat half-equation ke bare mein kya batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zyada positive E°: forward jaane ka rujhan zyada; baayen wali species asani se reduce hoti hai. Kam positive E°: reverse jaane ka rujhan zyada; daayen wali species asani se oxidize hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The less positive the value of E°, the greater the tendency for the half-equation to proceed in the reverse direction

blocks.prompt:
60 Using E° values, predict whether Cu(s) + Fe²⁺(aq) → Cu²⁺(aq) + Fe(s) is feasible (Fe²⁺/Fe = −0.44 V, Cu²⁺/Cu = +0.34 V).
(E° qeematon se bataein ke Cu(s) + Fe²⁺(aq) → Cu²⁺(aq) + Fe(s) mumkin hai ya nahi (Fe²⁺/Fe = −0.44 V, Cu²⁺/Cu = +0.34 V).)
blocks.explanation: Fe²⁺ reduce aur Cu oxidize hota: E°cell = E°red − E°ox = (−0.44) − (+0.34) = −0.78 V. Negative hai, is liye reaction mumkin nahi (ulta, Fe + Cu²⁺, mumkin hai).

book_ref.quote: On the other hand reaction between Ag⁺ and Mg is feasible

blocks.prompt:
61 Zinc reacts with Cu²⁺ ions, but copper does not react with Zn²⁺ ions. Explain.
(Zinc Cu²⁺ ions se react karta hai magar copper Zn²⁺ ions se react nahi karta. Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Zn (E° −0.76 V) mein Cu (+0.34 V) se zyada electrons khone ka rujhan hai. Is liye Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu ka E°cell = +1.10 V hai aur mumkin hai. Ulta, Cu + Zn²⁺, ka −1.10 V hoga aur mumkin nahi.

book_ref.quote: If the forward reaction is feasible, the reverse reaction (between Cu metal and zinc ions) is not feasible.

blocks.prompt:
62 How does the strength of oxidizing and reducing agents change as E° values become more negative?
(E° qeematein zyada negative hone par oxidizing aur reducing agents ki taqat kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: E° zyada negative hone par baayen wali species (oxidized shakal) kamzor oxidizing agents banti hain (kam electrons leti hain), aur daayen wali species (reduced shakal) taqatwar reducing agents banti hain (zyada asani se electrons deti hain).

book_ref.quote: The species on the right of the equation become stronger reducing agents.

blocks.prompt:
63 Copper cannot reduce Zn²⁺ ions. Which metal can, and why?
(Copper Zn²⁺ ions ko reduce nahi kar sakta. Kaun si metal kar sakti hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Zn²⁺/Zn (−0.76 V) se zyada negative E° wala taqatwar reducing agent chahiye. Mg²⁺/Mg ka E° zyada negative (−2.37 V) hai, is liye Mg asani se electrons deta hai aur Zn²⁺ ko reduce karta hai: Mg + Zn²⁺ → Mg²⁺ + Zn.

book_ref.quote: Cu will not reduce Zn²⁺ ions to Zn. So how can we reduce Zn²⁺ ions?

blocks.prompt:
64 Why are acidified KMnO₄ and K₂Cr₂O₇ oxidizing agents while KI and FeSO₄ are reducing agents?
(Acidified KMnO₄ aur K₂Cr₂O₇ oxidizing agents aur KI aur FeSO₄ reducing agents kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: KMnO₄ (+1.51 V) aur K₂Cr₂O₇ (+1.33 V) ki E° qeematein zyada hain, is liye yeh asani se electrons lete hain aur oxidizing agents hain. KI aur FeSO₄ ki E° qeematein kam hain, is liye yeh reducing agents hain.

book_ref.quote: Compounds can also act as oxidizing and reducing agents.

blocks.text: 10.18 Variation of E value with ion concentration

blocks.prompt:
65 How does the electrode potential of Zn²⁺/Zn change when [Zn²⁺] is (i) more than (ii) less than 1.00 mol dm⁻³?
(Zn²⁺/Zn ka electrode potential kaise badalta hai jab [Zn²⁺] (i) 1.00 mol dm⁻³ se zyada (ii) kam ho?)
blocks.explanation: Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ ⇌ Zn, E° = −0.76 V. (i) Zyada [Zn²⁺] equilibrium ko daayen le jata hai; E kam negative (maslan −0.61 V). (ii) Kam [Zn²⁺] use baayen le jata hai; E zyada negative (maslan −0.80 V).

book_ref.quote: If we change the concentration or temperature of half-cell X, the electrode potential also changes.

blocks.prompt:
66 How does increasing [Fe³⁺] in the Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ half-cell affect E? Use Le-Chatelier's principle.
(Fe³⁺/Fe²⁺ half-cell mein [Fe³⁺] barhane se E par kya asar parta hai? Le-Chatelier's principle se bataein.)
blocks.explanation: Fe³⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ Fe²⁺, E° = +0.77 V. [Fe³⁺] (baayen wali species) barhane se equilibrium daayen jata hai, is liye E zyada positive ho jata hai (Table 10.1 mein +0.85 V).

book_ref.quote: If we increase the concentration of the species on the left of the equation

blocks.prompt:
67 Write the Nernst equation and its simplified form at 298 K.
(Nernst equation aur 298 K par is ki saada shakal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: E = E° + (RT/zF) ln([oxidized form]/[reduced form]). ln x = 2.303 log x aur 298 K par R, T, F constant hone se: E = E° + (0.059/z) log([oxidized form]/[reduced form]).

book_ref.quote: The effect of concentration and temperature on the value of Ecell can be deduced using the Nernst equation.

blocks.prompt:
68 Calculate the electrode potential of a nickel electrode in 0.050 mol dm⁻³ Ni²⁺ at 298 K (E° = −0.25 V).
(298 K par 0.050 mol dm⁻³ Ni²⁺ mein nickel electrode ka electrode potential nikalein (E° = −0.25 V).)

book_ref.quote: [oxidized] refers to the concentration of the oxidized form in the half-equation

blocks.prompt:
69 Calculate the electrode potential of copper in 2.0 mol dm⁻³ Cu²⁺ at 298 K (E° = +0.34 V). Is it more or less positive than E°?
(298 K par 2.0 mol dm⁻³ Cu²⁺ mein copper ka electrode potential nikalein (E° = +0.34 V). Kya yeh E° se zyada positive hai ya kam?)
blocks.explanation: E = 0.34 + (0.059/2) log 2.0 = 0.34 + 0.0295 × 0.301 = 0.34 + 0.0089 = +0.35 V. Yeh E° se zyada positive hai, kyunke [Cu²⁺] 1.00 mol dm⁻³ se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: [reduced] refers to the concentration of the reduced form in the half-equation.

blocks.prompt:
70 For the cell Cu(s) + 2Ag⁺(aq) → Cu²⁺(aq) + 2Ag(s), how does Ecell change when [Ag⁺] is increased? Why?
(Cell Cu(s) + 2Ag⁺(aq) → Cu²⁺(aq) + 2Ag(s) mein [Ag⁺] barhane se Ecell kaise badalta hai? Kyun?)
blocks.explanation: [Ag⁺] barhane se Ecell zyada positive hota hai (Figure 10.11). Ag⁺ reactant hai (Ag⁺ + e⁻ ⇌ Ag ke baayen), is liye zyada concentration equilibrium ko aage dhakelti hai aur Ag⁺/Ag ka electrode potential zyada positive hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The above redox cell reaction makes the value of Ecell more positive.

blocks.text: 10.20 Activity series of metals and ease of oxidation

blocks.prompt:
71 What is the activity series of metals? How is it related to standard reduction potentials?
(Metals ki activity series kya hai? Is ka standard reduction potentials se kya taaluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Activity series metals ki reactivity, khaas taur par electrons khone ke rujhan, ke mutabiq darja bandi hai. Zyada negative reduction potential wali metals zyada reactive hain aur asani se oxidize hoti hain; zyada positive wali kam reactive hain.

book_ref.quote: The activity series of metals is a ranking of metals based on their reactivity

blocks.prompt:
72 Why do metals high in the activity series act as reducing agents?
(Activity series mein upar wali metals reducing agents kyun hain?)
blocks.explanation: In ke standard reduction potentials zyada negative hain, is liye yeh asani se electrons kho kar oxidize hoti hain. Electrons de kar doosron ko reduce karti hain, is liye reducing agents hain (maslan caesium aur sodium pani se zor se react karte hain).

book_ref.quote: Hence such metals act as reducing agents.

blocks.prompt:
73 Using Table 10.2, write the reaction of a divalent metal such as nickel with dilute HCl.
(Table 10.2 ki madad se nickel jaisi do-gerfi (divalent) metal ka dilute HCl se reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nickel (−0.25 V) hydrogen se upar hai, is liye acids se hydrogen nikalta hai: Ni(s) + 2HCl(aq) → NiCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). (Divalent metals ke liye balanced shakal mein 2HCl aur MCl₂ hain.)

book_ref.quote: Do not react with water. React with acids, replacing hydrogen.

blocks.text: 10.21 Feasibility of redox reactions from the activity series or reaction data

blocks.prompt:
74 Will zinc displace lead from a solution of Pb²⁺ ions? Use E° values (Zn²⁺/Zn = −0.76 V, Pb²⁺/Pb = −0.13 V).
(Kya zinc Pb²⁺ ions ke solution se lead ko nikal dega? E° qeematein istemal karein (Zn²⁺/Zn = −0.76 V, Pb²⁺/Pb = −0.13 V).)
blocks.explanation: Zn(s) + Pb²⁺(aq) → Zn²⁺(aq) + Pb(s). E°cell = −0.13 − (−0.76) = +0.63 V. Positive, is liye mumkin: zinc series mein upar hai aur lead ko nikal deta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is used to determine the products of single displacement reactions

blocks.prompt:
75 Will silver react with Ni²⁺ ions? Use E° values (Ni²⁺/Ni = −0.25 V, Ag⁺/Ag = +0.80 V).
(Kya silver Ni²⁺ ions se react karegi? E° qeematein istemal karein (Ni²⁺/Ni = −0.25 V, Ag⁺/Ag = +0.80 V).)
blocks.explanation: Ni²⁺ + 2Ag → Ni + 2Ag⁺ mein Ag oxidize hoti: E°cell = −0.25 − (+0.80) = −1.05 V. Negative, is liye mumkin nahi; silver series mein nickel se neeche hai.

book_ref.quote: if potential of the cell is positive, the reaction is possible if negative, the reaction is not feasible

blocks.prompt:
76 What is a photovoltaic cell? What does the word 'photovoltaic' mean?
(Photovoltaic cell kya hai? Lafz 'photovoltaic' ka matlab kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photovoltaic cell roshni ki energy ko bijli ki energy mein badalta hai. Lafz photo (roshni) aur volt (bijli ka potential) se bana hai.

book_ref.quote: The cell which converts light energy into electrical energy is called photovoltaic cell.

blocks.prompt:
77 State the principle of a photovoltaic cell.
(Photovoltaic cell ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh photovoltaic effect par kaam karta hai: roshni (photons) ki energy semiconductor mein electrons ko valence band se conduction band mein le jati hai. PN junction electrons aur holes ko alag kar ke voltage paida karta hai jo current chalata hai.

book_ref.quote: The central principle behind the operation of PV cells is the photovoltaic effect

blocks.prompt:
78 Give two merits of the photovoltaic cell as a sustainable source of energy.
(Photovoltaic cell ke sustainable (paaedaar) energy ke zariye ke taur par do fawaid bataein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Jab tak roshni ho photovoltaic effect jaari rehta hai; yeh dhoop ko bijli mein badalne wala renewable (dobara milne wala) zariya hai. (2) Yeh suraj ki energy istemal karta hai aur fossil fuels par munhasir nahi.

book_ref.quote: A photovoltaic system is a renewable energy source that converts sunlight into electrical energy.

blocks.text: 10.27 Winkler method, BOD and DO (numbered 10.27 as printed)

blocks.prompt:
79 Define biochemical oxygen demand (BOD).
(Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD) ki taareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: BOD qudrati pani mein organic maadde ki paanch din mein oxygen kharch karne ki salahiyat hai. Yeh dissolved organic maadde ki biological oxidation mein kharch hone wali oxygen ki miqdaar hai, jise pani ke microorganisms catalyze karte hain.

book_ref.quote: The value of BOD is the amount of oxygen consumed as a result of biological oxidation

blocks.prompt:
80 Define dissolved oxygen (DO). What is its normal range and minimum safe level?
(Dissolved oxygen (DO) ki taareef karein. Is ki aam had aur kam az kam mehfooz satah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: DO pani mein ghuli oxygen ki miqdaar hai, jo hawa se ya pani ke paudon ki photosynthesis se aati hai. Is ki concentration 5 se 8 mg/dm³ hai; kam az kam 5 mg/dm³ honi chahiye, is se kam ho to pani aaloodah samjha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Dissolved oxygen (DO) is defined as the amount of oxygen dissolved in water.

blocks.prompt:
81 Why do BOD and DO have an inverse relationship?
(BOD aur DO ka ulta taaluq kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bacteria organic maadda decompose karte hue pani ki oxygen kharch karte hain. Jitna zyada organic maadda decompose ho, BOD utni barhti hai aur dissolved oxygen (DO) utni girti hai.

book_ref.quote: As bacteria consume oxygen in the water while decomposing organic matter, BOD increases

blocks.prompt:
82 State the principle of the Winkler method.
(Winkler method ka usool bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dissolved oxygen oxidizing khasiyat rakhti hai aur KI se react kar ke iodine banati hai. Iodine ko starch indicator ke saath sodium thiosulfate se titrate kiya jata hai (endpoint par gehra neela). Banne wali iodine dissolved oxygen ke mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: Winkler method is a technique used to measure the amount of dissolved oxygen (DO) in water samples.

blocks.prompt:
83 How is BOD measured experimentally?
(BOD tajurbe se kaise naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Winkler method se: band pani ke sample ki oxygen concentration paanch din ke shuru aur aakhir mein naapi jati hai; is dauran sample andhere mein constant temperature par rakha jata hai. Farq kharch hui oxygen (BOD) hai.

book_ref.quote: in which a sealed water sample is maintained in the dark
